  df |> 
  group_by(gen) |> 
  slice(1)

  import("mmg.xlsx") |> 
  select(gen = GEN, mmg) |> 
  filter(!is.na(mmg))

Code
stats <- list(
  media = \(x){mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)},
  min = \(x){min(x, na.rm = TRUE)},
  max = \(x){max(x, na.rm = TRUE)},
  dp = \(x){sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)},
  var = \(x){var(x, na.rm = TRUE)},
  cv = \(x){cv(x)},
  li = \(x){confint(x)},
  ls = \(x){confint(x, return = "sup")},
  n = \(x){length(x)},
  nvalid = \(x){length(na.omit(x))}
)

# usando across()
dfrg |> 
  summarise(
    across(mg, .fns = stats)
  )
